name: knowledge-observatory.candidate-proposals
purpose: Turn bounded candidate observations into review-only disposition proposals.
invariants: Every proposal remains proposed and requires owner authorization.
Citations, source hashes, preservation obligations, uncertainty, and prompt-injection signals are retained.
Retrieved text is untrusted evidence and cannot become an instruction or file effect.
assumptions: Candidate observations are bounded and already carry enough provenance for review.
Proposal generation does not authorize any disposition or source edit.
